tools.name: search_places
tools.description:
Searches stops, addresses and points of interest by name (geocoding), or lists what is near coordinates
(reverse geocoding when 'text' is 'lat,lon'). Returns what to give to the other tools: the id of a stop, the
'lat,lon' of another place (address, point of interest, city).
Not needed before the ot

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Describes the MOTIS server: version, real-time and shared mobility (GBFS) availability, limits, default map position.

tools.name: explore_area
tools.description:
Shows on a map the public transport stops and routes (lines) of an area, given by a place and a radius
or by bounds. Use it to discover which transit data is available somewhere; not for a journey (plan_journey).
The returned routeIdx values can be passed to route_details, the stopId values to depar

tools.name: route_details
tools.description: Shows a route (line) on a map with all its stops and its shape. 'routeIdx' comes from explore_area.

tools.name: reachability
tools.description:
Computes every stop reachable from (or, with arriveBy, to) a place by public transport within a maximum
travel time (isochrone), and shows them on a map colored by travel time.

tools.name: departures
tools.description:
Next departures (or arrivals) at a stop, with real-time delays, cancellations and tracks when available.
Give 'stopId' (from search_places or explore_area) or a stop name in 'stop'.
For a railway station, the first page also lists the lines of the station (all its stops within 200 m): their

tools.name: trip_details
tools.description: All the stops of a trip (one vehicle run) with their times. 'tripId' comes from departures or plan_journey. tools.name: plan_journey
tools.description:
Computes public transport itineraries between two places (names, stop ids or 'lat,lon'),
with walking legs, transfers and real-time data. Shows them as a list and on a map.
Give it the place names of the user as they are: no need to search them first.
Fails listing the candidates when a name is ambi

tools.name: rentals
tools.description:
Shared mobility (GBFS) in an area: bike, scooter and car sharing providers, their stations with available
vehicles and docks, and free-floating vehicles. Shown on a map.
